-------1
select RIB_Date Current_CTL_Date, dateadd(dd,1,RIB_Date) Next_date_to_process
from 
    eds.eds_ctl ect


select fulldate,business_day_flag from eds.date_dim where fulldate in (select dateadd(dd,1,RIB_Date) fulldate from eds.eds_ctl ect)
